exposure: Women with spontaneous labor before scheduled cesarean
Women with recurrent uterine scar rupture
cohort: 38 women with a prior uterine rupture and 50 subsequent pregnancies
finding: Women with prior uterine rupture who underwent subsequent pregnancies managed at a tertiary medical center with planned elective term cesarean delivery had good maternal and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Of the 7 women who went into spontaneous labor before their scheduled cesarean, none experienced uterine rupture or dehiscence before delivery.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery was 36 weeks and 4 days
